snippet.title: This tarot card is 580 years old
snippet.description:
Before tarot told fortunes, it was a game. TRIONFI is a trick-taking card game with the Visconti tarot cards, painted in Milan around 1445.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5504420/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=short_lovers

Card: Cary-Yale Visconti tarocchi, Beinecke Library, Yale University.
Music: Suonatore di Liuto, Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0.
